patch_list: Assume device is online

Fixes "Something went wrong, please try again…" when pairing with the browser extension. StayFree gates all sync behind a precheck that must reach Google and that also refuses to sync while usage-data collection is opted out; local pairing…
Debug QR pairing path

Diagnostic only. Records why StayFree's QR pairing does or does not issue its pairing request — the two guards on the scanned code, and the device-group status the pairing coroutine checks before it reaches the network — to the same log as…
Disable All Telemetry

Removes and blocks all telemetry and analytics: SensorTower usage-data upload (app/web usage, browsing, shopping, AI prompts), Amplitude, Singular, Bugsnag, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics/Performance/Sessions, Google App Measurement, Faceb…
Fix MIUI permission check crash
Stops the Xiaomi/Redmi/Poco "background pop-up" permission check from crashing on AOSP-based ROMs ("Bad operation #10021"), which otherwise aborts device pairing with "Something went wrong".
Hide Google sign-in in Paired Devices
Hides the "Sign in with Google" button from the Paired Devices section in settings. Pairing with a code still works.
Hide texts
Hides the instruction text on the "Pair with code" screen: "Select the app you want to pair your Android app with:".
In-app QR scanner

Scans the browser extension's pairing QR code inside StayFree, like Brave's built-in scanner, instead of asking you to open the camera app (whose link can't open a patched app). Opens on its own when you choose to pair with a browser exten…
Local data backup

Replaces the Google Drive "Usage Data Backup" in Settings > Storage with a local backup: export your usage history, limits and settings to a zip file you pick, and restore them from one. Needs no Google account and no longer asks you to op…
Local device sync

Pairs the phone with the StayFree browser extension over your local network without data collection. The app runs a small sync server on port 8787 and serves its usage straight from Android, so nothing goes to StayFree/SensorTower. Removes…
Refresh paired devices list

Fixes Settings > Paired Devices staying empty after a device pairs successfully. StayFree reloads the device list and announces it on a flow that nothing observes, while the screen waits on a flow that nothing ever updates, so it never rec…
Remove App Info contents

Keeps the "App Info" row with the version number in Settings, but it no longer opens the App Info screen: Debug Usage Limit Problems, Data Privacy, StayFree Community, Support us, Credits & Open source libraries and the support App ID are…
Remove data collection opt-out

Removes the "Opt-Out of Data Collection" switch from Settings > Data Privacy and locks data collection off: the opt-out can no longer be undone (the "Opt-In" buttons do nothing) and the opt-out status is never reported to StayFree. Include…
Remove drawer sign-in
Removes the "Sign into StayFree" account row from the bottom of the side menu.
Remove Follow us
Removes the "• Follow us!" link next to "StayFree" at the top of the side menu. Tapping the header no longer opens StayFree's social media page.
Remove Get Help
Removes the "Get Help" row (HelpScout support chat) from Settings and from the settings search.
Remove Google login request
Removes the "Sign in with Google" page from onboarding and the "Create StayFree profile" step from the home setup checklist. Signing in manually from the drawer/pairing screens still works.
Remove Inbox Control

Removes the Inbox Control (Gmail cleaner) feature: its drawer entry, its permissions section and every screen that opens it. The Neon theme and custom app icons that were locked behind signing up for it are unlocked, and the Gmail sign-in…
Remove My Friends
Removes "My Friends" (usage sharing with friends through StayFree's servers) from the side menu and from the settings search.
Remove pair devices banner

Removes the "Tap to pair your devices for the best StayFree experience!" banner from the dashboard and the "Cross Platform is here" sheet it opens (Google login on each device, "Share Download Links").
Unlock all premium features
Unlocks every theme (gamification-level, Black and Neon themes) and all custom app icons without earning levels, pairing a device or signing up for Inbox Control.
